avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer reduces ticagrelor plasma concentrations and antiplatelet efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; use alternative herbal supplement if mood support needed

avoid_supplements.name: Ginkgo Biloba
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive antiplatelet/anticoagulant effects increase bleeding risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel on increased bruising and bleeding risk

avoid_supplements.name: Garlic (High-Dose Supplements)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potentiates antiplatelet activity and may inhibit CYP3A4, increasing ticagrelor levels
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid therapeutic garlic supplements; dietary garlic in normal amounts acceptable

avoid_supplements.name: Ginger (High-Dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive antiplatelet effects and potential CYP3A4 interaction
avoid_supplements.action: Limit to culinary amounts; avoid high-dose supplements

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 Fatty Acids (Fish Oil)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild antiplatelet properties may additively increase bleeding tendency
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased bruising; dose typically safe at standard supplementation

caution_supplements.name: Turmeric/Curcumin
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential mild antiplatelet effects and CYP3A4 inhibition at high doses
caution_supplements.action: Use culinary amounts; monitor if taking high-dose supplements

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin E (High-Dose >400 IU/day)
caution_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate antiplatelet effects at very high doses
caution_supplements.action: Recommend staying below 400 IU daily; standard supplementation acceptable

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition significantly increases ticagrelor plasma concentrations and bleeding risk
avoid_foods.action: Absolute contraindication; eliminate from diet; counsel on hidden sources (some juices, pomelos)

caution_foods.name: Cranberry Juice (High-Dose/Concentrated)
caution_foods.mechanism: May have mild antiplatelet properties and potential CYP3A4 interaction at excessive intake
caution_foods.action: Moderate consumption acceptable; limit concentrated supplements

caution_foods.name: Alcohol (Excessive)
caution_foods.mechanism: Heavy alcohol use potentiates bleeding risk and may affect drug metabolism
caution_foods.action: Counsel to limit alcohol to moderate amounts (≤1-2 drinks daily); avoid binge drinking

monitoring_notes: Monitor for signs of bleeding (spontaneous bruising, nosebleeds, bleeding gums, dark stools) and counsel patients to report all supplements and herbal products. Emphasize that ticagrelor's antiplatelet effect is essential for cardiovascular protection and should not be compromised by interacting substances.
